```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=45), paged.print=FALSE, results="hide"}
pca_theme <- theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 6)) + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 2.8),

        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 5.8),

        plot.margin = grid::unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 56),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 56),
        axis.ticks = element_blank())

SpeciesLabel.order <- c("FriCoe_Madrid", "FriMor_Flores", "FriMor_SaoMig",
                        "FriMad_Madeira", "FriCanOmb_Hierro", "FriCanBak_GranCan",
                        "FriCanCan_Gomera", "FriCanPal_Palma", "FriCanCan_Tenerife",
                        "FriPol_GranCan", "FriTey_Tenerife")

SpeciesLabel.colors <- c("black", "DarkRed", "DarkRed", "#E6AB02", "#006D2C",
                         "#31A354", "#708238", "#BAE4B3", "#708238", "#1F78B4", "#A6CEE3")

SpeciesLabel.color <- scale_color_manual(name = "Species_Island/Mainland",
                                          values = SpeciesLabel.colors,
                                          limits = SpeciesLabel.order,
                                          guide = "none")

SpeciesLabel.fill <- scale_fill_manual(name = "Species_Island/Mainland",
                                       values = SpeciesLabel.colors,
                                       limits = SpeciesLabel.order,
                                       guide = "none")

```

## READ AND CLEAN PCA DATA

```{r ps1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, fig.width=18, fig.height=8, paged.print=FALSE}

# WGS samples to exclude (matches exclusions in other scripts)
wgs_exclude <- c("132", "252", "89")

# Read PCA results
pca <- read_table(paste0(dataDir, "/variants_microbiome_subset_miss0.8_mac3_noZ_noLD.eigenvec"),
                  col_names = FALSE)
eigenval <- scan(paste0(dataDir, "/variants_microbiome_subset_miss0.8_mac3_noZ_noLD.eigenval"))

# Sort out the PCA data
colnames(pca) <- pca[1, ]
pca <- pca[-1, -1]
names(pca)[1] <- "WGS_ID"
names(pca)[2:ncol(pca)] <- paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(pca) - 1))

# Read and filter metadata
metadata <- read_delim(paste0(dataDir, "/WGS_Fringilla_samples.tsv"), delim = ",") %>%
  filter(Microb == 1)

# Join PCA with metadata
pca <- left_join(pca, metadata, by = "WGS_ID")

# Exclude WGS samples that fail QC or are duplicates
pca <- pca %>% filter(!`16S_Lab_Code` %in% as.numeric(wgs_exclude))

# Sanity check — should be 106
nrow(pca)

# Convert PCs to numeric (they come in as character from read_table)
pca <- pca %>% mutate(across(starts_with("PC"), as.numeric))

# Relevel factors so mainland is reference
pca$Species <- as.factor(pca$Species) %>% relevel("Fringilla coelebs coelebs")
pca$Species_Label <- as.factor(pca$Species_Label) %>% relevel("Mainland_F_coelebs")

# Chaffinch / Blue finch grouping
pca$Chaff_Blue <- ifelse(pca$Species %in% c("Fringilla polatzeki", "Fringilla teydea"),
                         "Bluefinch", "Chaffinch")

# Variance explained per PC
pve <- data.frame(PC = 1:10, pve = eigenval / sum(eigenval) * 100)
cumsum(pve$pve)

```

## PLOTS

```{r plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE, fig.width=18, fig.height=8, paged.print=FALSE}

# PC1 vs PC2
(pca_species_pc1_2 <- ggplot(pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = Label, shape = Label)) +
   geom_point(size = 10, color = "black") +
   scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23, 22, 21, 25, 21, 21, 22, 21, 21, 25), guide = "none") +
   labs(x = paste0("PC 1 (", signif(pve$pve[1], 3), " %)"),
        y = paste0("PC 2 (", signif(pve$pve[2], 3), " %)")) +
   SpeciesLabel.color + SpeciesLabel.fill +
   scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
   pca_theme)

# PC1 vs PC3
(pca_species_pc1_3 <- ggplot(pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, fill = Label, shape = Label)) +
    geom_point(size = 10) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23, 22, 21, 25, 21, 21, 22, 21, 21, 25), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = paste0("PC 1 (", signif(pve$pve[1], 3), " %)"),
         y = paste0("PC 3 (", signif(pve$pve[3], 3), " %)")) +
    SpeciesLabel.color + SpeciesLabel.fill +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    pca_theme)

# PC1 vs PC3 inset version (larger points, no axis text)
(pca_species_pc1_3_inset <- ggplot(pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, fill = Label, shape = Label)) +
    geom_point(size = 18) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23, 22, 21, 25, 21, 21, 22, 21, 21, 25), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = paste0("PC 1 (", signif(pve$pve[1], 3), " %)"),
         y = paste0("PC 3 (", signif(pve$pve[3], 3), " %)")) +
    SpeciesLabel.color + SpeciesLabel.fill +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01), position = "left") +
    pca_theme_inset)

```
